name: Human Archive (HA-Multi)
tagline: 36-episode sample (3.9 h, 11 household tasks): 6 synced cameras, 256-taxel tactile gloves on both hands, 8 IMUs, LeRobot v3; full set sold.

annotations.format: LeRobot v3: Parquet (data/, meta/episodes, meta/tasks), JSON (meta/info.json, stats.json), H.264 MP4 per camera
annotations.coverageNote: All 36 episodes carry tactile, IMU and a task label at 30 fps (<33 ms alignment). The HF repo humanarchive/HA-Multi-Samples now returns 401 (withdrawn).

action_labels.note: One task label per episode (11 tasks: cleaning, cooking, ironing, folding...)

hand_pose.note: Glove IMU quaternion + per-finger bend derived from 256 taxels (no joints)

camera_pose.note: Intrinsics + 74.95 mm stereo baseline published; no trajectory

depth.note: Head-mounted 1280x720 stereo pair for depth reconstruction (no depth maps)

annotations.sample:
# data/chunk-000/file-000.parquet columns (per frame, 30 fps), from the dataset card
episode_index, timestamp,
observation.tactile.left (256,), observation.tactile.right (256,),
observation.tactile.left_glove_imu (12,), observation.tactile.right_glove_imu (12,),
observation.imu.head (9,), observation.imu.chest (6,),
observation.imu.left_bicep (6,), observation.imu.right_bicep (6,),
observation.imu.left_forearm (6,), observation.imu.right_forearm (6,),
observation.imu.left_hand (4,), observation.imu.right_hand (4,)
# meta/episodes: episode 0 = Cooking, Kitchen, 26,469 frames, 14.7 min
